responsibility: Declares the evrp_range_analyzer class that provides scoped, dominator-walk-oriented SSA value-range tracking for early VRP. The interface exposes block enter/leave hooks, statement range recording, temporary range push/pop support, and a small adapter for condition simplification, while inheriting the core vr_values range table and storing the unwind stack plus the policy for whether discovered ranges should also update global SSA range metadata.
same_name_distinction: Defines the evrp_range_analyzer class interface, inheritance from vr_values, and its stored unwind stack/update policy, while gcc/gimple-ssa-evrp-analyze.c provides the operational range-analysis logic for entering/leaving blocks and deriving/pushing ranges from edges, PHIs, and statements.
